# TexFx Outline attribution

Adapted from TexFx by SinsOfSeven, `OutlinePixelShaderRegex.ini`,
version 1.0661. The template also credits Annplan for custom outline colors.
The original template and its CC BY-SA 4.0 International license are
retained alongside this file. `GimiOutlineContract.h` contains the
adapted pattern, replacement, temporary-register and declaration contract.
